headline: Budget transfers for wastewater projects, opioid recovery services, hazmat training, and hazardous waste collection.
summary: The committee will consider seven budget authorization resolutions covering wastewater infrastructure projects, an opioid recovery service expansion at 200 Elm St., hazmat training, community health worker funding, and household hazardous waste collection.
